criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: Raw Purdue BuildingShapesZip4 feature FID 651 identifies FSTE / First Street Towers Eastern at 1230 1st Street.
Independent 0.10 m raster overlay from raw EPSG:4326 source and candidate outline gives IoU 0.9934; candidate area from the fresh-open record is 1304.58 m².
Top-down candidate render follows the irregular GIS footprint, including its setbacks and projecting wings.
criteria.finding: Identity and structural footprint are strongly verified against Purdue's directly identified GIS feature.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
evidence: Candidate structural wall bounds in the fresh-open record agree with Purdue GIS bounds to 4 decimal places in the repository's local XY conversion.
Independent raster comparison reports 0.9934 IoU at 0.10 m sampling.
criteria.finding: The plan orientation, dimensions, and local campus placement match the GIS outline. The documented transform is an approximation, not a surveyed control network.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Purdue GIS FID 651 reports six levels; the asset contains six floor plates and repeated residential stories.
The Purdue 2009 complex photograph visibly supports peaked gable roof language, but does not identify the East wing; exact 23.25 m top height, floor spacing, and two FSTE gables remain estimates.
criteria.finding: Floor count is supported and the roof interpretation is plausible at complex level. Height and the East tower's precise roof configuration are not independently verified.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
evidence: The reviewed exterior render shows warm red-brown brick, pale window frames, blue-gray glazing, floor-course bands, and modeled gable forms consistent with the complex-level Purdue reference.

A glazed representative entry is modeled on the 1st Street-facing edge; the model evidence documents its distance and alignment to OSM way 5332639. The exact East-wing door and facade bay rhythm are not sourced.
criteria.finding: Material and residential-window language are plausible. The modeled entry and facade rhythm remain interpreted because available imagery is not East-wing-specific.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Exact candidate SHA-256: 7f92c5bb44c8a5d1f1f5aee145003234e0fb3dd9e6e77dc18fb2dee84dfe94ae; expected revision hash matches: True.
Candidate's fresh-open record confirms scene and named export collection, 87 mesh objects, 13 materials, and no external texture files or validation errors.
Building evidence includes source snapshots, footprint diagnostics, exterior and entry views, and a six-level 22-room schematic interior cutaway with uncertainty disclosed.
criteria.finding: The saved collection and materials are self-contained according to the fresh-open validation record, and evidence is complete for a schematic asset. The shared manifest still has stale object-count and height metadata and needs coordinator reconciliation before integration.

evidence.source: Purdue University BuildingShapesZip4 FeatureServer layer 0, FID 651; EPSG:4326 snapshot retrieved 2026-10-26

findings: Purdue GIS independently verifies identity, orientation, plan dimensions, and near-exact structural footprint.
The source supports six floors and complex-level brick/window/gable design language; East-specific height, entry, facade schedule, and roof details remain estimated.
The modeled interior is clearly schematic, uses the published 22-room cluster and private-bath program, and does not claim an as-built plan.
The fresh-open validation is from the candidate evidence; the grader environment has no Blender executable, so a second independent Blender reopen could not be run.
The shared manifest remains stale for this revision and should be corrected by the coordinator before master integration.
methodology: Exact asset hash check; raw GIS GeoJSON read directly and transformed with the project local approximation; independently rasterized polygon overlap at 0.10 m resolution from GIS ring and candidate fresh-open structural outline; reviewed candidate renders and original Purdue complex-level photo. The candidate's exact Shapely metrics and Blender reopen record were treated as corroborating evidence, not as the independent comparison. No builder score was used.
